tagline: Leading provider of proprietary reservoir description and production enhancement services to the global oil and gas industry.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI reflects the company's strategy to focus on high-value-added services, which represent 76% of revenue in 2025. It captures Core Labs' commercial positioning as a provider of proprietary technology solutions rather than commoditized products.

kpis.name: Services % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated from services.
kpis.description: The proportion of revenue derived from services versus product sales, indicating the company's strategy to focus on proprietary technology solutions.

kpis.name: Product Sales % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated from product sales.
kpis.description: The proportion of revenue from manufactured products produced at the company's four global production facilities.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The total number of employees operating across more than 70 offices in over 50 countries, reflecting the company's operational capacity and global footprint.

kpis.name: Share of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customer transactions that incorporate artificial intelligence-related solutions or features.
kpis.description: Measures the integration of AI technologies into the company's service and product offerings.
kpis.signal: Early indicator of client adoption of AI capabilities.

kpis.name: Energy transition services revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from services supporting energy transition projects, such as carbon capture or geothermal projects.
kpis.description: Represents contribution from energy transition-related activities, including carbon capture and storage (CCS), geothermal, and mining evaluation for energy materials, explicitly mentioned in Core Labs' strategy.
kpis.signal: Company positioning in emerging markets related to sustainable energy and carbon emission reduction goals.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share during the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital returned to shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Dividends + cumulative buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings per share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Indicates the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: 10-K filing delay and NYSE non-compliance
risks.summary: The company was notified by the NYSE for failing to timely file its 10-K form, jeopardizing its stock exchange listing.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in the document with direct impact on stock exchange compliance (NYSE). The language indicates a risk of delisting if the form is not filed within six months, which constitutes an existential threat. The fact that the filing was made after notification reinforces the severity of the lapse. The Regulation category is heavily weighted here. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Errors in published tax information
risks.summary: The company had to correct a $2.0 million overstatement in its deferred tax expenses, reducing its tax liabilities and increasing net income.
risks.score_rationale: The correction of a $2.0 million tax adjustment in a prior report (Form 8-K/A) reveals a weakness in financial controls. Although it did not affect revenues or cash flow, it impacts the credibility of financial statements. The language indicates a significant overstatement, and the context following a late filing amplifies the risk of loss of confidence. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Unhedged foreign exchange risk
risks.summary: Fluctuations in exchange rates can directly impact the company's results, particularly in countries where it holds assets or liabilities in local currency.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in multiple international regions with over 70 offices in more than 50 countries and does not use any derivative instruments to hedge its foreign exchange risk. Gains and losses are directly recorded in earnings. The language is factual but the risk is recurring and unmitigated, making it significant in a context of monetary volatility. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on oil and gas producers' capital expenditures
risks.summary: Sensitivity to oil and natural gas price cycles and client investment spending on exploration and production represents a major risk to demand.
risks.score_rationale: Demand for Core Labs' services is highly correlated with long-term investment trends by oil and gas producers, which in turn depend on commodity prices. The MD&A indicates that periods of low or volatile prices reduce client investments and therefore demand for services. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory risk related to climate and energy policies
risks.summary: Governments are adopting legislation and regulatory initiatives (Paris Agreement, European Climate Law) that could restrict oil and gas operations and reduce demand for Core Labs' services.
risks.score_rationale: The company and its customers are subject to compliance with government regulations related to climate change, energy conservation, and energy transition initiatives. Stricter regulations, carbon taxes, or restrictions on oil and gas production could reduce demand for services. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The company CLB did not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar terms in the provided excerpts from its 10-K filing. Therefore, its positioning on AI cannot be determined from this information.
